additional_info.subject: 0390442 - ID0390442-DC/Si-D/TR-[multi] Downgrade to v4.0.11 CRM:00314000129
additional_info.body:
Good morning Emre,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0390442,
opened for downgrade request to v4.0.11 of
55 chargers.
I downgraded the chargers in the past days. Attached you can find an excel sheet with all the details. A few remarks from my side:
Charger
ugY7tg
is downgraded. Since before downgrade, it has a critical error flag
SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income - surge protection income.
An onsite visit is necessary to restore the charger.
Charger
a1qTgA
is downgraded. Since before downgrade, it has a critical error flag
12VDC_Supply_TB18_FC23 - problem with TB18 or FC23.
An onsite visit is necessary to restore the charger.
Charger
0R2bCs
is downgraded. Since before downgrade, it has the emergency stop button pressed.
Charger
vHDjdC
is not coming back online on SCB after downgrade was launched. An onsite visit is necessary to check router XF1 and, in case downgrade didn't go through, to flash the CFast card with v4.0.11. I can provide you with the config files and support if needed.
Charger
s7UcN0
is offline on SCB since 18.11.2024. A remote downgrade was not possible. In case the charger is not offline on purpose, an onsite visit is necessary to check router XF1.
Charger
CZN9hh
is offline on SCB since the morning of 20.11.2024.  A remote downgrade was not possible. In case the charger is not offline on purpose, an onsite visit is necessary to check router XF1.
I am available for any further clarification. Should I move the ticket to your queue, or do you need further support from my side for the downgrades of the above open points?
In the meanwhile, I will ask R&D to apply the RETOPICS Hotfix on all the chargers.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
